status: locked design before validation and evaluation
primary: mean of 0.75*RescueNet_DVR + 0.25*Alibaba_DVR across fixed load/battery cases
selection: min validation mean primary loss; ties smaller aging fraction
mechanism: Consider ready tasks. Prefer those whose estimated service fits deadline, horizon and battery while paying hover+CPU power.
Among feasible tasks waiting >= alpha*(deadline-ready), choose EDF with FIFO ties.
If no feasible candidate, run shortest service with FIFO ties. No rejection, idling, preemption or model changes.
ablation_weights: same selected alpha as FULL; not independently retuned
scope: development mechanism pilot; shared source pools and fixed spatial layout; no source holdout, final test, DRL or novelty claim
inference: paired mean differences with seed-cluster bootstrap across all six fixed scenarios; descriptive pilot intervals only
